rationale: Both reach 9 walks, or 36 miles, with sound reasoning by different routes. A lists the walking days for all three starting offsets in both 28- and 29-day Februaries, so the minimum of 9 is shown exhaustively. B argues conceptually that 28 = 9*3 + 1, so the nine full 3-day cycles each contain exactly one walk, which gives a lower bound of 9. It then shows an alignment that achieves 9. A is more exhaustive and B more elegant; neither has a gap.
